# Marc Dalessio

> A naturalistic painter's portfolio showcasing plein air landscapes, portraits, and travel paintings from Europe and Asia, alongside workshops and artistic philosophy.

Marc Dalessio is a contemporary oil painter specializing in landscape and portrait work, with extensive experience painting en plein air across France, Portugal, Spain, Thailand, Cambodia, and other destinations. The site documents his artistic practice, exhibition work, and teaching through painting workshops.

## Core Portfolio

- [Meet the Artist | Marc Dalessio](https://marcdalessio.com/about): Artist biography and statement by naturalistic painter Marc Dalessio
- [Landscapes | Marc Dalessio](https://marcdalessio.com/landscape-painting): Portfolio of landscape paintings by Marc Dalessio, plein air and studio work
- [Portraits | Marc Dalessio](https://marcdalessio.com/portrait-paintings): Portfolio of portrait paintings and commission work by Marc Dalessio

## Travel & Regional Series

- [Paintings from Recent Travels | Marc Dalessio](https://marcdalessio.com/paintings-from-recent-travels): Plein air paintings from travels to Spain, Portugal, Thailand, Cambodia
- [Landscape Painting in The Gers | Marc Dalessio](https://marcdalessio.com/landscape-painting-in-the-gers): Landscape paintings of Gers region in southwestern France by Dalessio
- [Regards sur le Gers | Marc Dalessio](https://marcdalessio.com/regards-sur-le-gers): Exhibition of plein air paintings of Gers department, Occitanie, France
- [The Estremoz Paintings | Marc Dalessio](https://marcdalessio.com/the-estremoz-paintings): Oil painting series from three years living in Estremoz, Portugal
- [Algarve and Costa Alentejana Paintings | Marc Dalessio](https://marcdalessio.com/algarve-and-costa-alentejana-paintings): Plein air coastal paintings from Algarve and Costa Alentejana, Portugal
